title: Russian man who swam from Kaliningrad to Lithuania in asylum attempt sentenced to six years hard labour
content: A 68-year-old Russian man who swam across the Nemunas River from Russia's Kaliningrad exclave into neighbouring Lithuania in an attempt to seek asylum has been sentenced to six years in a strict-regime penal colony in Russia for "publicly justifying terrorism."

content: In a televised address from his official residence the French prime minister acknowledges young people anger 'doesn't come from nowhere' and promises a plan to respond to the crisis

title: Maricarmen, symbol of Spain's housing protests, dies
content: The 87-year-old woman had withstood four eviction attempts in the past decade. In a final message from her hospital bed, she urged protesters: "Fight!"

title: Rubio in Athens urges Europe to shoulder more of its defence burden
content: The US secretary of state held talks on energy, military cooperation and regional security, pointing to Greece as an example of higher defence spending. The agenda also included LNG, F-35s, the Eastern Mediterranean and the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Armed Man shot outside Sweden's Royal Palace in Stockholm
content: Swedish police have shot and wounded an armed man outside the royal palace in central Stockholm. The man has been taken to a hospital.

title: Swedish Patriot missiles to be sent to Poland to bolster NATO's eastern flank
content: Sweden will send Patriot air-defences and around 100 troops to protect the Rzeszów-Jasionka logistics hub used to route aid to Ukraine. The mission starts on 1 December and will last seven months.

title: EU-China trade tensions: Five things to know as Brussels and Beijing face crunch talks
content: The next ten days will be critical for EU-China relations. EU Trade Commissioner Maroš Šefčovič will travel to Beijing later this week for high-level talks aimed at rebalancing the trade relationship and securing “tangible” results ahead of next week’s meeting of EU leaders.

title: Brussels eyes agricultural carve-outs from Ukraine's EU membership
content: The European Commission proposed excluding Ukraine's agricultural products from the EU market and agricultural funding even when Kyiv joins the EU, in a move to smooth the country's accession process and address concerns from several member states.

title: 500 arrested as French police clashes with protesters on third day of national action by high school students
content: Eyewitnesses say police deployed tear gas to quell unrest and disperse crowds in major cities including the capital, Paris, Marseille and Lyon. Officials figures reflected a nationwide participation exceeding a quarter million students in the protests that have rocked Macron's government.
